Name: Stardew i18n Translator
Author: Neko41
Description:
[b]Stardew i18n Translator[/b]

A portable Windows tool for translating Stardew Valley / SMAPI mod i18n files without editing huge JSON files by hand.

I made this because translating directly in text editors gets annoying fast. One broken placeholder, token, quote, comma, or JSON bracket can break a translation. This app gives you one searchable editor, tracks progress, and checks the risky parts before export.

[b]Supported languages[/b]

[b]Source:[/b]
[list]
[*]English / default.json[/*]
[/list]
[b]Built-in Stardew target languages:[/b]
[list]
[*]German (de), Spanish (es), French (fr), Hungarian (hu), Italian (it), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Portuguese (pt), Russian (ru), Turkish (tr), Chinese (zh)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Custom language:[/b]
[list]
[*]Vietnamese (vi), Indonesian (id), Ukrainian (uk), Polish (pl), Finnish (fi), Dutch (nl), Czech (cs), Thai (th) [/*]
[/list]
Thai works as a custom Stardew language target. Since Stardew does not ship official Thai game text, official glossary hints may only be available when a compatible community language pack is installed.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Scans SMAPI mods for i18n files[/*]
[*]Imports existing translations[/*]
[*]Groups multi-part mods together[/*]
[*]Tracks translation progress[/*]
[*]Search, filter, review, and bulk-edit entries[/*]
[*]Checks Stardew, Content Patcher, dialogue, mail, and placeholder tokens[/*]
[*]Supports manual translation[/*]
[*]Optional local AI through Ollama or LM Studio[/*]
[*]External LLM batch export/import[/*]
[*]Builds clean translation files, backups, and installable translation ZIPs[/*]
[*]Can generate short Translation Notes for sharing[/*]
[/list]
AI translations are always marked as Needs Review. The app never treats AI output as finished automatically.

[b]Installation[/b]

Download the ZIP, extract it somewhere writable, and run stardew-i18n-translator.exe.

The app creates a data folder next to the EXE. Keep that folder when updating or moving the app, otherwise you may lose settings, glossary data, and translation progress.

Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required. It is already installed on Windows 11 and most Windows 10 systems.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the EXE is currently unsigned.

[b]Privacy[/b]

No accounts, analytics, telemetry, cloud API keys, Nexus API access, or automatic uploads.

Local AI requests only go to the endpoint you configure. External LLM batch files only leave your computer if you upload them somewhere yourself.
